descriptions.job-1wdwai9:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is investing in building out its Capital Product Sales team to actively engage SaaS platforms and Marketplaces to embed our loans into their own experience, helping their users get access to needed financing.

Stripe's global Product Sales team is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem solving. Within Stripe, Product Sales proudly serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on Stripe’s product roadmap and growth strategy.

What you’ll do

As a Capital Product Account Executive at Stripe, you will use your sales and product expertise to help drive growth of the Capital for Platforms offering, with a primary focus on new customer acquisition. You will create and execute a territory plan, lead outbound prospecting, develop relationships with prospective customers, and build a strong pipeline of qualified Capital opportunities.

You will partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams to lead strategic deals from initial outreach through activation. You'll run in-depth product conversations with prospective and existing customers and help shape go-to-market strategy for new products.

You build relationships naturally across customers and internal stakeholders, including executives. You know how to create demand, build value in competitive situations, and move complex opportunities forward. You combine deep product instinct with technical curiosity and you're energized by becoming the expert others turn to. 

Responsibilities

  • Be accountable for driving revenue by acquiring new marketplace and platform customers. 
  • Lead outbound prospecting efforts, create qualified pipeline, and develop opportunities from initial outreach through contract and activation.
  • Identify customer and industry signals that indicate a strong fit for Capital, and develop tailored account strategies based on those signals.
  • Partner with core Account Executives and other Product Account Executives to open new customer relationships and position Capital as an entry point to the broader Stripe platform.  Lead discussions with our largest prospective customers.
  • Develop trusted relationships across complex buying groups, including executive, product, finance, technical, legal, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Build a strong understanding of the competitive landscape and communicate the value of Stripe Capital.
  • Contribute to the development of go-to-market playbooks alongside Product, Marketing, Sales, and Technical Services stakeholders.
  • Serve as both an internal and customer-facing expert on Stripe’s Capital product.
  • Use Stripe’s wide-ranging payments expertise and market insights to create product narratives supported by rigorous analysis.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 6 years of client-facing experience at a leading technology, payments, financial services, or management consulting firm.
  • A track record of creating outbound pipeline, acquiring new customers, and progressing complex opportunities through the full sales cycle.
  • Experience developing and executing territory and account plans with a high degree of independence.
  • Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, ideally with enterprise customers or platforms.
  • Experience presenting to and building trusted relationships with senior business leaders.
  • The ability to work effectively through ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.
  • An enthusiastic, hands-on approach to developing new opportunities and solving customer problems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
descriptions.job-0b76soh:
About the role

Trading Systems runs the infrastructure Flow Traders trades on: the global Linux fleet — trading servers, workstations and VDIs — and the multi-cloud and distributed-systems estate that sits alongside it. We also build and run the self-service infrastructure platform the rest of Technology depends on.

We are hiring two engineers into this team. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes on writing Terraform, building CI workflows and guardrails, automating toil out of the Linux fleet, and operating what you build. A lot of the shared tooling does not exist yet, and building it is the job rather than a side effect of it. The environment is trading-critical and runs across both on-premise infrastructure and public cloud, and you will work on both sides of that line rather than specialising in one.

To be clear about the shape of the seat: this is build-and-operate rather than architecture, strategy or management. There is architecture in it, but the bulk of the work is hands-on and there are no direct reports. A solid Linux foundation is essential across the whole role — it underpins both sides of the estate, and the cloud, container and Kubernetes work rests on it just as much as the on-premise fleet does.

What you will do

  • Write, debug and publish reusable Terraform modules that other engineers consume, covering both the Linux fleet and the cloud estate.
  • Design and own CI/CD workflows and guardrails in GitHub Actions — the policy checks, tests and approval gates that let engineers across Technology self-serve infrastructure safely.
  • Build and operate Kubernetes on both sides of the estate — managed clusters in cloud and k3s on-premise — along with the distributed systems running on it, particularly Kafka.
  • Provision and operate GCP, AWS and Alibaba Cloud resources through Infrastructure as Code.
  • Operate and automate the Linux estate: Foreman provisioning across VMs and bare metal, Puppet for host configuration, Ansible/AWX for application deployment, plus patching and lifecycle.
  • Build automation and internal tooling in Python or Go, with test-driven development as a normal working habit.
  • Take a share of the global 24/7 on-call rotation, and cross-skill deliberately between the Linux and cloud sides of the estate.

What you will need to succeed

  • Strong Terraform experience, including writing, debugging and producing reusable modules for others to consume.
  • CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions — and the guardrails, not only the pipelines. We want to hear about the gates and policy checks you built and why each one exists. Equivalent GitLab CI or Jenkins experience is fine.
  • Solid Kubernetes in production across workloads, CNI, Helm and Argo. Self-managed or bare-metal clusters are a strong plus, as is contributing to or authoring operators.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning and operating GCP or AWS through Infrastructure as Code, with an appetite to go deeper.
  • Strong Linux fundamentals — you can debug a production host without a runbook: processes, networking, storage, systemd, logs, kernel versus user space.
  • Proficiency in Python or Go, with demonstrable experience of test-driven development.
  • Direct experience of production on-call and incident response, and a considered view on what makes a rotation sustainable.
  • Typically 5+ years in infrastructure, platform or systems engineering. Fluent written and spoken English. Based in the Amsterdam area or willing to relocate — this role is on-site and is not remote.

Nice to have

  • A genuine cross-domain background — both Linux/systems and cloud/platform, rather than one of them plus a passing acquaintance with the other.
  • GCP specifically, as our primary cloud.
  • Kafka in production. Real Kafka depth would be a significant win for us.
  • Our fleet tooling: Puppet for host configuration management at scale, Ansible and AWX, and Foreman.
  • Bare-metal and datacenter infrastructure — provisioning, hardware lifecycle, virtualization (VMware, Proxmox) — and networking depth across routing, load balancing, BGP and multicast.
  • Financial services, trading, or another high-availability, latency-sensitive environment. Dutch is useful but not required.

descriptions.job-1rz8e5t:
Own Your Intelligence

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

You'll build and operate the storage systems that feed frontier AI workloads. Own reliable, high-throughput access to datasets, checkpoints, and model artifacts, balancing performance, durability, availability, and cost as GPU clusters scale.

Core Technical Responsibilities

  • Design and operate storage architectures for training datasets, checkpointing, inference artifacts, and shared research workflows

  • Deploy and tune parallel filesystems, object storage, and local NVMe caching for demanding AI workloads

  • Benchmark throughput, latency, metadata performance, and concurrent access with representative training and checkpoint workloads

  • Build provisioning, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and operational automation for storage services

  • Design and test replication, recovery, backup, and failure-handling procedures with explicit durability and availability targets

  • Diagnose performance and reliability issues across applications, clients, networks, filesystems, and devices

  • Implement access controls, tenant separation, quotas, monitoring, and runbooks; collaborate with compute and networking teams

Technical Requirements

Required Experience

  • 3+ years building or operating production distributed storage systems

  • Hands-on experience with at least one parallel or distributed filesystem or object storage platform, such as Lustre, BeeGFS, Ceph, or GPFS

  • Strong Linux administration and performance troubleshooting skills

  • Experience automating infrastructure operations in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages

  • Understanding of storage failure modes, data integrity, consistency, replication, and recovery

Infrastructure Skills

  • Block, file, and object storage semantics and their performance tradeoffs

  • NVMe/SSD performance, filesystem tuning, I/O profiling, and benchmarking

  • High-throughput storage networking and distributed client behavior

  • Capacity forecasting, observability, alerting, and safe maintenance procedures

  • Authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure data lifecycle management

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large GPU training clusters and high-volume checkpoint workloads

  • S3-compatible object storage, data tiering, or distributed caching

  • RDMA-enabled storage or GPUDirect Storage experience

  • Kubernetes storage integrations or SLURM environments

  • Storage cost optimization and contributions to open-source storage systems

Growth Opportunity

You'll work directly with customers pushing the boundaries of AI, from startups training foundation models to enterprises deploying massive inference infrastructure. You'll collaborate with our world-class engineering team while having direct impact on systems powering the next generation of AI breakthroughs.

We value expertise and customer obsession - if you're passionate about building reliable, high-performance GPU infrastructure and have a track record of successful large-scale deployments, we want to talk to you.

Apply now and join us in our mission to democratize access to planetary scale computing.

Compensation

Cash compensation range of $150,000–$300,000 plus equity incentives.
descriptions.job-1tszo1d:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality through Afterpay, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. 

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

Job Description

The Global Account Management team is looking for a tenured account manager, consultant, or sales professional with experience managing high-value technical accounts to help retain and grow Square's presence in the Mid-Market space across Ireland.

You will work with top C-level executives and technical leaders, finding creative ways to make Square's ecosystem work in complex, global organizations. You will identify ways to expand Square's reach with customers and act as an internal advocate for Square's highest-value clients.

The ideal candidate will have worked in Mid-Market Account Management, business development, consulting, partnerships, sales or sales engineering and will be well-versed in working with and presenting to senior decision makers, including C-level executives, IT, finance and operations. They will have experience managing projects with multiple company partners on behalf of customers. Internally at Square, you will work in collaboration with product, engineering, finance, implementation, marketing, legal and sales to ensure successful establishment and growth of our customers.

You Will:

  • Build partnerships and establish lasting, fruitful relationships with existing customers to retain and grow our presence within large organizations
  • Take full ownership of your managed book and oversee business prioritization, financial contract structuring, legal negotiations, technology strategy and ongoing account management
  • Discover challenges and aspiration with customers within your book and use Square's platform and product portfolio to grow their success through up-sell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Partner with sales colleagues to establish and grow newly on-boarded, high-value customers
  • Be the "voice of the seller" curating analysis of product performance from your managed book and provide relevant feedback to inform for product roadmap decision-making
  • This role will require travel to visit our customers on site

You Have:

  • 5+ years experience in account management, business development, consulting, partnerships, sales or sales engineering focused on technical products
  • Experience achieving revenue metric goals related to growth and churn prevention
  • In-depth experience collaborating internally with partners on complex deals or partnerships
  • Experience requirements gathering with customers, building business cases for feature development with products teams, while balancing expectations for both parties
  • Formal sales methodology training and experience conducting formal QBRs
  • Experience supporting go-to-market efforts for new products

descriptions.job-05po20h:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Strategy & Operations (S&O) team for Infra is responsible for enabling the continued rapid growth and operational excellence of one of Stripe's most strategic areas - the infrastructure group. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, strategy, finance, data, GTM and day-to-day execution, ensuring the infra organization is well-informed, running efficiently and poised to deliver on the future product needs. 

As a key member of this team, you will tackle a diverse array of challenges that underpin Stripe’s technical foundations which will span system scalability, platform reliability, and efficiency. You will provide the analytical rigor and operational pragmatism necessary to scale Stripe’s infrastructure in a way that is both technically resilient and fiscally sustainable. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will lead critical strategic projects, translate complex system performance and capacity trends into actionable infrastructure requirements, and drive the high-stakes architectural and resource decisions necessary for Stripe’s long-term growth.

The Infrastructure Strategy & Operations team is a vital partner to Stripe’s engineering leadership and the Office of the CPTO, focused on three core pillars:

  • Setting and Driving the Engineering Agenda: We design the organizational structures and operating models that enable our infrastructure to scale ahead of the business. We lead critical technical governance forums and synthesize system-level health metrics such as utilization, latency, and fleet reliability into strategic insights for senior leadership.
  • Strategic Capacity & Infrastructure Planning: We deliver objective, data-driven strategies for our platform roadmap. By modeling future infrastructure needs against business growth forecasts, we ensure our global hardware and software investments are proactive rather than reactive, bridging the gap between deep engineering requirements and financial reality.
  • Program/Process Incubation:  We add structure and clarity to ambiguous problems, leading and influencing large cross-functional teams to stand up and define new programs and processes that simplify how we run the business. We lead cross-functional initiatives to stand up new programs focused on infrastructure efficiency and resource optimization without compromising developer velocity.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Infrastructure leadership to define the long-term strategic vision and build the annual operating plans, ensuring alignment with Stripe's overall company strategy.
  • Maintain a pulse on the financial health/cost of Infrastructure including relevant trends, and proactively surface areas of concern or opportunity.
  • Build and own models for in-depth analyses & benchmark key metrics to help inform our overall strategy and make the right growth decisions for Infrastructure.
  • Obsess over our top infrastructure efficiency metrics, helping to surface, track, and drive initiatives that will move the needle.
  • Support cross-functional execution across priority projects, ensuring alignment between teams (e.g., product, engineering, marketing, sales, support).
  • Design and implement operational systems and processes (e.g., reporting dashboards, planning forums, decision-making workflows) that help the infrastructure group scale efficiently.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in strategy & operations, data science, finance, product management, or similar roles at technology companies
  • Experience working in highly cross functional settings, and in a role that spans strategy, analysis, and operations in a fast-paced environment
  • Critical and first principles thinking (e.g., ability to question how we are working rather than simply executing), and the ability to zoom out to the most important questions  
  • Passion for digging deep into data and problem solving
  • Experience in data analytics with demonstrated ability in navigating large data sets and/or SQL
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with the the ability to speak to leaders across different teams, such as partnerships, product, engineering, and sales
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in influence without authority environments
  • Good balance of business and technical acumen
  • An ability to execute with minimal guidance, and in contexts with a high degree of ambiguity

Preferred qualifications

  • Previous experience in Infrastructure strategy (e.g., Compute, Storage, Networking, IT, Security or Developer Platforms), the Payments ecosystem, or high-scale Fintech is highly preferred. 
  • Proven ability to facilitate large-scale technical forums and planning sessions, maintaining a  focus on measurable goals, infrastructure SLAs, and ROI-driven outcomes.
  • Experience driving creative solutions for capacity and efficiency bottlenecks, with a track record of effectively influencing the roadmaps of cross-functional engineering and product teams.
descriptions.job-01oufzl:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Ripple is looking for a highly skilled Privacy Senior Manager to join our team. This opportunity empowers you to strengthen, scale, and manage the programmatic and day-to-day activities of our Global Privacy Program. You will be a proven individual contributor, helping us drive our privacy initiatives and elevate our operational standards globally. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Assist in managing the day-to-day aspects of global privacy operations, including processing data subject requests, improving current processes, updating inventory, and data mapping, and leading privacy impact assessments.
  • Support the continued development and operationalization of the global program, including updating policy and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Stay informed about relevant global privacy legislation and lead the implementation of any new requirements that may arise.
  • Develop and conduct privacy training to ensure adoption throughout the organization.
  • Maintain program metrics to proactively identify risks and trends.
  • Support and maintain privacy tools.
  • Prepare ad-hoc and quarterly reports, presentation slides, and program material for employees, subsidiaries and senior leadership.
  • Provide operational support to the Regulatory Compliance team in ad-hoc matters related to licensing, operational resilience, outsourcing and others.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • Bachelors Degree from an accredited university or college.
  • 6-8+ years of privacy program management experience. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the financial technology or crypto industry.
  • Experience drafting and reviewing privacy related contract terms.
  • Experience supporting global privacy initiatives, including understanding of US state privacy laws, EU GDPR, UK data protection regulations, and other international privacy regimes. 
  • Strong analytical, organizational and program management skills, with an attention to detail.
  • Ability to adapt to shifting priorities, work well under pressure, and adhere to deadlines.
  • Strong communication (presentation, writing, speaking) and interpersonal skills, including the ability to tailor content to specific audiences and break down complex requirements into actionable requirements.
  • Commercially-minded team player who embraces uncertainty and excels at solving complex privacy issues within the financial services sector.
  • Comfortable completing tasks independently in a team environment with minimal supervision.
  • Privacy certification

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The AI GTM team is focused on one of Stripe's most strategic growth opportunities: enabling AI-native and AI-enabled businesses to scale on Stripe. We're in a unique position – partnering with the world's most ambitious AI companies (the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, and NVIDIA) building on the frontier of artificial intelligence – across infrastructure, foundation models, agents, and applications – to grow globally with the help of Stripe's financial infrastructure.

As part of Stripe's GTM organization, this team works closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to shape Stripe's AI GTM strategy and ensure that the world's leading AI companies – from early-stage innovators to the largest public players – choose to build with Stripe. 

What you'll do

Work collaboratively with one of Stripe’s most strategic customers to realize their business goals. Our customers in the AI Industry move fast, you’ll work alongside your customer to develop and execute a multi-year partnership strategy that accelerates their ambitions with Stripe as a critical partner. 

This is a role that will require you to be an active participant in Stripe’s product strategy across the company, acting as a proxy for your customer within the walls of Stripe. You will interact with executives internally and externally to ensure your customer’s needs are well understood and prioritized. You will:

  • Own full commercial sales cycles and partnership opportunities, from business case development, to deal structuring and negotiating, to close
  • Develop a strategic account plan to expand Stripe’s commercial footprint within your customer’s business, driving growth through cross-sell, expansion, and new revenue streams 
  • Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your customer’s business, deeply understanding problems they are trying to solve and helping them find durable solutions
  • Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating meaningful conversations with the appropriate stakeholders, internally and externally, to expand the customer relationship
  • Lead and contribute to team projects, further Stripe’s use of AI tools and agents, and help refine our sales processes and culture in Stripe’s GTM organization

Who you are

We're looking for someone who operates with vision and urgency at the highest levels of enterprise sales. You combine deep commercial creativity with the executive presence to negotiate landmark agreements, and the strategic judgment to know which problems matter most. You thrive in ambiguity, create clarity for others, and have a track record of building and closing the largest, most complex deals in your organization's history.

Minimum requirements

  • Demonstrated success closing transformational partnerships with bespoke commercial structures
  • 13+ years of sales experience selling technical products to large enterprises, with a sustained track record of top performance and quota overachievement
  • 4+ years leading complex sales cycles with Enterprise organizations required
  • Track record of leading and orchestrating large cross-functional teams through complex deal cycles with competing priorities
  • Proven ability to build and maintain executive relationships at the C-suite level and influence strategic decision-making
  • Ability to understand complex technical architectures and craft creative solutions that span multiple products and commercial models
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across a complex organization and subsidiaries 
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to command a room of senior executives
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the AI industry 
  • History of shaping org-wide sales practices, mentoring peers, and contributing to team strategy beyond individual quota attainment

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling into or partnering with frontier AI companies, hyperscalers, or developer-first platforms 
  • Understanding of AI monetization models (token-based pricing, usage-based billing, consumption entitlements, API rate structures)
  • Prior experience at a high-growth technology company where you helped define the go-to-market approach for a new or nascent market segment
  • Familiarity with Stripe's products and the broader fintech/payments ecosystem
descriptions.job-1wc5375:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

Why this role exists

BitGo's product is the foundation of the crypto industry globally. Our products and services are used by a breadth of client types worldwide: exchanges, banks, fintechs, asset managers, protocols, corporates, and governments. Much of the industry's infrastructure ultimately runs on or intersects with our platform. Delivery at that scale, across that many client types and jurisdictions, is executed by single-threaded PM owners. The individual workstreams are owned. What is not owned is the connective tissue between them: delivery operating rhythm, cross-team dependencies, regulatory submission pipelines, audit-driven remediation programs, etc that cut across product, engineering, compliance, legal, and finance.

You will join as the first program manager for R&D and build the Technical Program Management function from scratch within your first year. This is not a process-improvement role. It is an execution-risk role at a public company where missed delivery on regulated commitments has audit, examiner, and investor consequences.

What you will own

Timely and predictable delivery of product. This is the mandate everything else serves. You own delivery integrity across the product portfolio: dates that mean something, cross-team and cross-entity programs (acquisition integrations, legal-entity restructurings, partner and vendor migrations) executed end-to-end, and early escalation the moment a plan and a commitment diverge. When BitGo says something ships, it ships.

Building trust between product and our regulatory, compliance, legal, finance, and audit partners. Run the programs where product delivery and control exposure intersect: new-product regulatory review pipelines with fixed examiner deadlines, remediation of audit findings where the fix is a product build, and delivery against commitments made to regulators. These partner teams need to trust that product's plans are real and product needs to trust that review clocks are predictable; you are the person who makes both true, and who forces conflicts between remediation timelines and exposure windows into explicit decisions rather than letting them ride.

Portfolio dependency and capacity integrity. Maintain the single source of truth for where resources are allocated, which programs must land when, and what is at risk. Surface contradictions, such as committed goals with unstaffed critical-path dependencies, duplicate ownership, or cross-team dependencies that live in nobody's plan, before they surface as quarter-end misses. Build a credible picture of keep-the-lights-on load so real capacity is known, not guessed.

Portfolio dependency and capacity integrity. Maintain the single source of truth for where resources are allocated, which programs must land when, and what is at risk. Surface contradictions — committed goals with unstaffed critical-path dependencies, duplicate ownership, cross-team dependencies that live in nobody's plan — before they surface as quarter-end misses. Build a credible picture of keep-the-lights-on load so real capacity is known, not guessed.

The product operating rhythm. Run the execution-review cadence for the product org: initiative status that is current and honest, launch readiness that commercial can sell against, and a working blocker-escalation path with SLAs. You make status cheap to produce and impossible to fudge.

The TPM team. You start as the first program manager for R&D, hands-on, running the highest-exposure programs yourself, and build out the function within a year, hiring 1–2 TPMs against proven need. Set the bar for what program management means here: outcome-accountable, technically fluent, and light-touch on teams that are already delivering.

What success looks like in the first two quarters

  • Every regulated-delivery program has a dated plan reconciled against its external deadline, with gaps escalated in writing. There should be no compliance commitment tracked in a spreadsheet nobody owns.
  • Committed goals and staffing are reconciled: zero commitments with unstaffed critical-path dependencies that leadership hasn't explicitly accepted.
  • One integration or entity program demonstrably run end-to-end through your operating model.
  • Product leads report the coordination overhead went down, not up. If the org experiences TPM as a reporting tax, the function has failed regardless of the dashboards.

Who you will partner with

  • Product managers, who keep outcome accountability and decide what to build. You take the cross-team coordination load off their plate and bring escalation muscle when a blocker sits in another org.
  • Engineering leadership, who own technical decisions, estimates, and delivery. You provide program-level sequencing and a single dependency view across teams, operating by partnership rather than positional authority.
  • Compliance, legal, and risk, who own regulatory judgment. You build the delivery machine around that judgment — submission pipelines, review-clock tracking, and remediation plans mapped to the audit calendar.
  • Commercial leadership, who own revenue and client commitments. You give them launch dates they can sell against and a real intake path when deal-driven commitments need to enter the roadmap.
  • Finance and audit, for whom you keep control-remediation milestones honest against the audit calendar, with slippage escalated the week it happens.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in technical program management, with 3+ leading TPM teams or functions, ideally including founding one.
  • Delivery leadership in a regulated financial environment: you have run programs with examiner deadlines, audit findings, SOX-adjacent controls, or material-weakness remediation, and you know how public-company audit exposure changes program management.
  • Technically credible with platform engineering: you can read an architecture discussion, pressure-test an estimate, and hold your own on sequencing conversations with senior engineers without pretending to be one.
  • Demonstrated experience with at least one of: M&A integration, legal-entity restructuring, or large multi-party partner migrations.
  • Operates through influence in organizations where authority is split across reporting lines. You get things done with people who don't report to you and don't want another meeting.
  • Writing-first operator: your default artifacts are documents and dependency maps, not status meetings.
  • Crypto/digital-asset domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. Regulated-fintech delivery scar tissue matters more.

What will make you fail here

  • Treating this as a process-rollout role. The org is allergic to ceremony and the CEO is hands-on; value has to show up as delivered programs, fast.
  • Needing positional authority to operate. Engineering does not report into product; you will coordinate across that line daily.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.

Here are some of the benefits* of working at BitGo:

  • Competitive base salary, bonus and stock options
  • 100% company paid health insurance for employee, partner and dependents
  • Up to 4% 401k company match
  • Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
  • Free custom lunches, dinners and snacks 
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and inspiring startup environment

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you’ll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

Pay Transparency Notice: Depending upon your leveling the compensation for this role averages between $200,000 - $230,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus and the benefits outlined above are also a part of this role's package.

About Us:
Founded 20 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America, Europe and Asia. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.

Overview:
We are looking for a 2027 Quantitative Research Intern to join our equities team, where you will focus on generating systematic signals across multiple time horizons. This role is ideal for candidates with a strong quantitative foundation and hands-on experience in either high-frequency orderbook research or longer-term signal generation—whether through academic projects, prior internships, or independent research.

You will work side-by-side with our senior researchers and traders to explore market data, develop predictive signals, and build models that directly inform real trading decisions. This is an opportunity to gain direct exposure to how quantitative research is applied at a leading proprietary trading firm.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze market data to uncover patterns, inefficiencies, and predictive signals across different time horizons
  • Build and backtest quantitative models using historical market data in a simulation environment
  • Apply statistical and machine learning techniques—with an emphasis on tree-based methods—to enhance signal quality
  • Collaborate closely with traders and researchers to translate research insights into robust trading strategies
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of data pipelines for large-scale, high-frequency, and time-series market data
  • Iterate on research prototypes based on backtest results and team feedback, under the guidance of experienced mentors

Requirements:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Financial Engineering, or related)
  • Expected graduation in 2027 or 2028
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including standard data science libraries (pandas, NumPy, etc.)
  • Genuine curiosity about financial markets and market microstructure
  • Solid foundation in statistics and quantitative analysis
  • Strong problem-solving skills and intellectual curiosity
  • Experience in high-frequency research and/or longer-term signal generation is a plus
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-motivated, with a strong desire to learn and collaborate in a fast-paced team environment

DV is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms. Only search firms with valid, written agreements with DV should submit resumes in response to DV’s posted positions. All resumes submitted by search firms to DV via e-mail, the Internet, personal delivery, facsimile, or any other method without a valid written agreement shall be deemed the sole property of DV, and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by DV. DV is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our platform computes hundreds of millions of invoices per billing period and continues to scale rapidly to accommodate new customers.   • Ability to work comfortably with data, reports, and operational dashboards * Proven track record of taking ownership and driving tasks to completion

Preferred

What You'll Bring

  • Operational Precision & Settlement Discipline * Liquidity Management & Forecasting * Risk Identification & Controls Implementation * Cross-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration * Data Analysis, Reporting & Dashboard Management

You'll Know You're Winning When

  • 100% of daily fund transfers, exposure settlements are executed on time with zero settlement failures * Liquidity buffers are consistently maintained across all exchanges with no operational disruptions * All custody positions are reconciled and documented with RCAs on identified gap on a daily basis * Risk flags and threshold breaches are identified and escalated proactively - before they escalate into incidents * Dashboards and reports provide real-time visibility into custody health and liquidity positions * Cross-functional partners rely on Custody Ops as a trusted, proactive operational layer

What Success Looks Like

If you are passionate about operational excellence, digital assets, and building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of financial services, this role puts you at the core of CoinDCX's growth story.

Join CoinDCX and help build the custody backbone of the future of finance.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Design organization builds the product and brand experiences that millions of businesses and developers rely on. We’re a cross-functional, global organization of product designers, content designers, design researchers, design systems engineers, motion designers, and design program specialists.

Our mission is to make economic infrastructure simple and accessible. Design plays a central role by making complex flows understandable, crafting clear product language, and building consistent systems that scale.

The Design Operations team leads Design’s business operations, runs cross-organizational programs, and builds the systems that help teams collaborate and produce high-quality work. Design Program Managers guide complex programs through the design lifecycle and apply design thinking to our operating model. They prototype and iterate on how our team works.

We’re looking for a Design Program Manager to partner with the Research team. This full-time role reports to the Head of Design Operations.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Lead and build programs for the Research organization. Develop and implement processes and resources that support impactful research and scale the use of user insights across Stripe.
  • Improve our operating model and processes, including automating tasks, improving workflows, and developing repeatable methodologies. Measure the impact of these changes.
  • Prepare researchers to use agentic workflows, including designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows.
  • Build custom tools, agents, automations, and skills for Research workflows and responsibilities.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools with researchers and cross-functional partners to support new capabilities across Stripe.
  • Work with researchers and designers across disciplines, skills, backgrounds, and specialties. Identify patterns and scale successful tools and approaches for broader team use.
  • Partner with Research leadership and the Design Operations team to balance competing priorities and make effective use of team resources. Identify potential obstacles and risks to key programs. Develop solutions, solve problems effectively, and use decision-making frameworks to support timely resolution.
  • Source and evaluate third-party vendors when needed. Work with Legal, Security, and Procurement to onboard and pay vendors, including managing statements of work, business terms, and budgets.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • You understand research work. You have direct experience in Design or can quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures relevant to Stripe researchers. You recognize that understanding someone’s work is necessary before changing it.
  • You have hands-on experience building artificial intelligence (AI) agents, automations, and tools. You’ve built solutions that changed how work gets done, and you can build alongside the people you support.
  • You’re an effective coach and communicator. You adapt your approach to different audiences and help people adopt new ways of working.
  • You recognize patterns and think in systems. When you build something that works for one person, you look for ways to make it useful to others.
  • You’re persistent and versatile, with skills that can apply across the company.
  • You prioritize action and speed. You can show someone a useful proof of concept on their own deliverable today, while continuing to build toward longer-term platform goals.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in design thinking, qualitative or quantitative research, user experience, or program management, including experience partnering with research teams.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building AI-powered tools, agents, automations, or workflows that improved real work processes for designers, researchers, creative teams, or product teams.
  • Experience coaching, teaching, or enabling others, formally or informally, with evidence of changes in how people work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt your style to different learners.
  • Experience working across multiple workstreams and relationships at the same time. You’ll support a Research team that works across Stripe’s product, marketing, support, and design teams.
  • A product-builder mindset for solving the last-mile problem: turning standalone AI experiments into polished, production-ready products that are easy to find and use.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with research and design tooling ecosystems, such as Qualtrics, Sprig, Figma, Dovetail, or design system management tools.
  • Experience with AI development tools and platforms, such as Claude, Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, application programming interface (API) integrations, or workflow automation tools.
  • Experience with change management, organizational transformation, or large-scale enablement programs.
  • Experience building and scaling internal tools, templates, or playbooks adopted beyond your immediate team.
descriptions.job-0pk5m5t:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

Your role

Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.

To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.  At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2027, or equivalent work experience; New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience).
  • Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
  • Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
  • Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

  • One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 
  • Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.
  • Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.
  • Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.
  • Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.
descriptions.job-028lng1:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Make Alpaca scale by owning and resolving the operating constraints Corporate Operations prioritizes.

Your mission is to take high-impact operating constraints from discovery through measurable outcome: drive them to resolution, establish durable ownership with the right long-term owner, then move to the next priority. You parachute into unfamiliar domains (HR, Finance, Engineering capacity, regional operating models, broker dealer bottlenecks, and more), diagnose what's actually limiting scale, create the solution, and stay accountable until the outcome actually changes. You are a builder-operator, not a coordinator. You work on the problems Corporate Operations has prioritized as highest-value for the company right now.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Own prioritized constraints end-to-end. Take cross-functional operating problems from zero context through measurable outcome. When the constraint is removed and the fix persists, you move on. You do not hold permanent territory in any function.
  • Work in any domain, including BD ops when it's the bottleneck. This month that might be HR automation or Finance close; next quarter decision delegation or Engineering throughput; later a broker dealer constraint (AML scale, reconciliations, operational readiness) if that's where Alpaca is stuck. Domain expertise is not the job. Systems thinking across unfamiliar domains is.
  • Sense → Design → Build → Drive. Measure what's happening, redesign what's broken, create the processes/automation/governance/infrastructure needed (or mobilize Engineering, Product, ORE, or functional teams when that's the right answer), and drive adoption until the outcome changes.
  • Partner across the company. Work directly with functional leaders and their teams to mobilize resources and drive adoption. You influence priorities and surface capacity needs; you do not absorb the function or run their day-to-day execution.
  • Create non-linear leverage. Ask whether workflow redesign, automation, org design, better decisions, vendor changes, or hiring is the right lever, and use whichever applies. Success means creating leverage so Alpaca needs fewer incremental people to support the same growth in the areas you touch.
  • Contribute to company deep-dives. Help establish baselines for velocity, capacity, and friction in the areas you work in.
  • Communicate capacity honestly. Be explicit about trade-offs and escalate when scope or priority needs Director or VP input, including when work should be deferred.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Builder-operator with end-to-end ownership. Proven track record taking ambiguous, high-stakes problems from zero context to measurable outcome. You don't hand off recommendations and walk away.
  • Systems thinker who learns fast. Able to parachute into unfamiliar domains, map workflows/capacity/decision systems, diagnose root cause, and become effective without deep prior subject-matter expertise.
  • Influence without authority. Proven ability to mobilize cross-functional teams, partner with senior stakeholders, and drive adoption among people who don't report to you.
  • Prioritization and judgment. Able to distinguish root cause from symptoms, focus on what matters, and push back with evidence when scope drifts.
  • Analytical rigor. Comfortable establishing metrics, measuring before/after, and using data, not anecdotes, to diagnose problems and prove impact.
  • High ownership through implementation. You finish what you start. Adoption and lasting change matter as much as the design.
  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex, cross-functional operating initiatives from diagnosis through implementation and measurable outcome.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience in internal product, strategy/ops, business operations, or operational transformation with strong builder instincts.
  • Strong fluency in AI and automation as tools for creating operating leverage.
  • FinTech or brokerage exposure is helpful in BD ops contexts. The job is operating pattern recognition, not securities expertise.
  • Capability spikes in systems/product build, executive orchestration, or quantitative capacity analysis.

What This Role Is Not:

A PMO project manager, business analyst who hands off recommendations, permanently embedded functional ops leader, process documentation role, product manager owning a product roadmap, or coordinator who stops at diagnoses and handoff. Functional leaders retain their teams and recurring execution; you own the constraint until it is resolved and durable ownership is established.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and unlock new business opportunities. We are looking for an outstanding compliance professional to join our fast-growing team as the Compliance Analytics Associate. This role, reporting to the Americas Head of Compliance, will support the day-to-day operation of our AML, CTF, sanctions and financial crime framework, with particular responsibility for transaction monitoring, blockchain investigations.

Role:

The role will be responsible for defining and implementing the firm's on-chain monitoring and travel rule framework and strategy. 

This is an excellent opportunity for a compliance professional looking to develop their career within a fast-paced fintech environment, with exposure to complex financial crime investigations, regulatory requirements and compliance technology. They will be comfortable working directly with Product and Engineering to design, automate and continuously improve the compliance function – including using AI-enabled tools to increase the speed and quality of investigations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Use Chainalysis to investigate wallet addresses, transaction histories, transaction flows and exposure to high-risk entities or services.
  • Define controls covering, Wallet screening, Sanctions exposure, Mixer/Tumbler activity, High-risk jurisdictions, Layering and obfuscation patterns, Rapid movement of digital assets, Wallet hopping and network relationships, Establish integration between crypto monitoring and traditional fiat AML controls.
  • Review direct and indirect exposure and assess the relevance of identified risk indicators.
  • Investigate Chainalysis alerts and determine appropriate next steps based on the customer's profile and transaction activity.
  • Support the development and refinement of transaction monitoring rules, thresholds and blockchain-related risk indicators.
  • Identify emerging crypto financial crime typologies and support the development of appropriate monitoring controls.
  • Ensure that the company’s travel rule program complies with anti-money laundering regulations by monitoring, collecting, and securely transmitting required sender and receiver data.
  • Provide guidance and informal training to other members of the Compliance team on Chainalysis, travel rule, and blockchain investigations.
  • Contribute to the development of internal guidance and best practice for blockchain investigations.
  • Work directly with Engineering and Product to design and build automated workflows around transaction monitoring, alert triage and case management.
  • Translate compliance and investigative requirements into clear technical specifications that developers can build against.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual, repetitive elements of blockchain investigations (e.g. wallet clustering, exposure scoring, evidence gathering) and help scope the solution with engineering.
  • Use AI/LLM-based tools to accelerate investigation write-ups, alert summarisation and typology research, while applying appropriate human judgement and quality control.
  • Contribute to the architecture of the compliance technology stack, including how Chainalysis integrates with internal case management, monitoring and reporting systems.
  • Stay current on emerging AI and automation capabilities in blockchain analytics and financial crime detection and assess their practical application to the business.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • 3+ years' experience in Compliance, AML, Financial Crime, KYC, Transaction Monitoring or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience with Chainalysis, ideally including Chainalysis KYT and blockchain transaction investigations.
  • Hands-on experience with Notabene (preferred)
  • Experience conducting KYC/CDD, EDD and transaction monitoring reviews.
  • Experience investigating financial crime alerts and documenting evidence-based conclusions.
  • Good understanding of cryptocurrency transactions, blockchain technology and crypto financial crime typologies.

  • Good judgement and the ability to make proportionate, risk-based decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple cases and priorities.
  • Comfortable working directly with developers/engineers to scope, build and test compliance tools and workflows.
  • Experience or strong interest in using AI/LLM tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to improve efficiency and quality of compliance work.
  • Ability to think in terms of process design and system architecture, not just policy and case-by-case decisions.

descriptions.job-1975cfl:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. 
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a product-driven marketing leader to accelerate the growth and adoption of OKX products across North East Asia.
This is not a traditional brand or events-focused marketing role. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, Marketing and Business, with a strong focus on understanding CeFi products, identifying market opportunities, and translating them into measurable user and business growth.
The ideal candidate has strong product sense, understands crypto users and trading behavior, and is highly data-driven. You should be comfortable working closely with Product, BD, VIP, Affiliate and local market teams to identify growth opportunities, build GTM strategies, and continuously improve acquisition, activation, engagement, retention and monetization.
You will also need strong judgment when operating across different market and regulatory environments, ensuring that growth strategies, user targeting and marketing execution are appropriate for each market.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the product growth marketing strategy for NEA, with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes, including user acquisition, activation, trading activity, retention and revenue.
  • Develop a deep understanding of CeFi products and crypto trading, including Spot, Derivatives, Earn, Copy Trading, Trading Bots, VIP products and other key trading tools, and identify which products and features can become meaningful growth drivers in each market.
  • Build and execute product-led GTM strategies based on local user behavior, competitor dynamics and market opportunities rather than relying primarily on brand campaigns or offline events.
  • Work closely with Product, Business, BD, VIP, Affiliate and regional teams to translate product capabilities into user acquisition, conversion and monetization opportunities.
  • Use data to understand the full user funnel, identify growth bottlenecks and continuously optimize campaigns, product positioning, incentives, conversion journeys and user segmentation.
  • Understand and effectively use different digital and growth marketing tools, including performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL/influencer channels, promotions and incentive mechanisms.
  • Develop clear user segmentation strategies across retail traders, active traders, high-value users and other relevant customer groups, and design differentiated product propositions and growth strategies for each segment.
  • Act as the voice of NEA users to global Product teams by identifying product gaps, competitive disadvantages and emerging user needs, and help prioritize opportunities that can materially improve growth.
  • Conduct structured analysis of competitors, including their products, pricing, incentives, campaigns, user journeys and growth mechanisms, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for major marketing initiatives, with strong accountability for their impact on product adoption and business growth.
  • Develop market-specific GTM strategies with appropriate consideration for local regulatory requirements, user targeting, communication boundaries and distribution approaches, working closely with relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Build scalable growth playbooks that can be tested in individual NEA markets and expanded when proven successful.

What We Look For In You

  • Strong CeFi and crypto product knowledge is essential. You should understand how centralized exchanges work and be familiar with major trading products, user journeys and the competitive landscape.
  • Strong product sense — able to understand why users choose one product over another, identify product-market gaps, and translate product capabilities into compelling growth propositions.
  • Highly data-driven and commercially minded. Comfortable using data to diagnose problems, prioritize opportunities and measure whether marketing initiatives actually contribute to user and revenue growth.
  • Strong understanding of digital growth tools and mechanics, including performance marketing, CRM/lifecycle marketing, referral, affiliate, KOL channels, promotions, incentives and conversion optimization.
  • Proven experience driving measurable business or product growth, rather than primarily managing branding, communications, events or community activities.
  • Strong understanding of crypto user behavior, particularly active traders and high-value users. Direct crypto trading experience is highly desirable.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Product and Business teams and influence priorities without relying on direct reporting lines.
  • Strong market judgment and awareness of how growth strategies may need to differ across regulatory and market environments.
  • Ability to balance growth ambition with responsible execution, including appropriate user segmentation, targeting, communication and channel strategies.
  • Strong analytical capability in market research, competitive analysis, funnel analysis and campaign performance.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to turn complex product and market insights into clear priorities and executable plans.
  • Experience in major North East Asian crypto markets is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in 1 or more NEA Language and English.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured primarily by the number of campaigns, events or impressions generated.
We expect this leader to demonstrate measurable impact on:
  • Product adoption and active users
  • Trading activity and revenue
  • Acquisition and activation efficiency
  • User retention and reactivation
  • Conversion of high-potential user segments
  • Successful adoption of priority products in NEA
  • Identification and closing of meaningful product and market gaps
  • Effectiveness of collaboration between Marketing, Product and Business teams

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. Brand Studio lays the foundations that help Stripe accelerate. Senior Brand Designers at Stripe demonstrate a passion for the craft of design and a deep understanding of how design communicates brand essence.   • Working knowledge of emerging AI tools and how they fit into a professional creative production workflow
  • Strong track record delivering high quality work independently, and in close collaboration with cross-functional partners
  • Find a meaningful balance between optimizing for speed, quality, and doing challenging, interesting, frame-perfect work

Preferred qualifications
